meta.note: There are 700 nodes and 700 ranks in seven regions: str, agi, dex, int, wis, vit and lck. Each region is a spine of twenty Normal nodes with twelve clusters of five Normal nodes and a Notable, and a Keystone leaf on the clusters the catalogue assigns. A free centre start connects the first spine node of every region; spine06 and spine20 are ringed to the neighbouring region, and four junction Notables bridge spine04 of str–agi, dex-int, wis–vit and lck–str. Normal nodes grant +1 to their own Core attribute, Notables grant their profile, and Keystones are grantless bundles paid in attainment. Every node has one rank; the layout is derived from the seven-spoke placement, never hand-placed.

nodes.name: Ironwall
nodes.description: All Evasion Rating becomes Armour at 1:1. You can no longer evade.

nodes.name: Redline
nodes.description: Landed hits grant Rage, up to 10 stacks: +3% damage per stack, and you lose 0.5% of Max HP per second. Rage fades after 3 seconds without a landed hit.

nodes.name: Headsman
nodes.description: Hits that leave a normal enemy at 15% HP or less execute it; Bosses and Uniques execute at 5%.

nodes.name: Crimson Pact
nodes.description: Physical hits deal 50% immediately; the other 50% becomes Bleed over 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Painforged
nodes.description: Damage prevented by Block is banked, up to 20% of Max HP, and adds to your next Physical hit.

nodes.name: Crushing Rhythm
nodes.description: Basic attacks are capped at 1 per second; faster attack speed instead multiplies their damage.

nodes.name: Armourbreaker
nodes.description: Physical hits break 5% of the target starting Armour, up to 60%. It returns after 4 seconds without a Physical hit.

nodes.name: Thornbound
nodes.description: Taking a hit retaliates for 20% of Armour as Physical damage every 0.5 seconds. Your own direct damage is halved.

nodes.name: Unstoppable
nodes.description: Stun no longer stops you and Slow no longer slows your attacks; while either would apply, you deal 25% less damage.

nodes.name: Worthy Foe
nodes.description: The third hit on one target starts a duel: +30% damage dealt to it and -20% damage taken from it. Hitting another target resets.

nodes.name: Barkskin
nodes.description: Every 2 seconds without losing HP or ES grants a Bark charge, up to 5. An evaded hit that would damage you spends one charge to take 40% less damage.

nodes.name: Ghost Dance
nodes.description: An evaded hit restores ES equal to 3% of Evasion Rating, capped at 10% of Max ES once per second. You cannot Block.

nodes.name: Instruments of Virtue
nodes.description: Alternating Attack and Spell actions grants 35% more damage to the next action. Repeating a type grants nothing.

nodes.name: Disrupting Blows
nodes.description: A hit that removes at least 5% of a target Max HP delays its next action by 0.5 seconds, within the shared control budget.

nodes.name: Shield Gate
nodes.description: When ES breaks, the hit overflow does not reach HP. Rearms after ES refills and 8 seconds pass.

nodes.name: Unerring Eye
nodes.description: Your hits cannot miss from Accuracy or Evasion, but can no longer crit. Dodge and Block still apply.

nodes.name: Demolition Sequence
nodes.description: Every 5 landed hits on one target detonate it and one nearby enemy for 20% of the HP lost to those hits.

nodes.name: Elemental Equilibrium
nodes.description: After an Elemental hit, that Element resistance rises 10 points and the others fall 20 for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Plague Courier
nodes.description: On a critical hit, move one Burn, Poison or Bleed from you to the target, keeping its damage and remaining duration. 4-second cooldown.

nodes.name: Elemental Infusion
nodes.description: Gain 30% of Physical damage as extra Elemental damage, split by your existing Flat Elemental damage.

nodes.name: Elemental Conduit
nodes.description: Elemental damage gained as extra can apply its Element status through Alignment, once per Element per hit.

nodes.name: Auto Cleanse
nodes.description: A newly applied abnormal status is removed at once, with a 6-second cooldown.

nodes.name: Emberheart
nodes.description: 100% of Physical damage becomes Fire after crit, before resistance.

nodes.name: One Flame
nodes.description: 50% of your Fire Resistance bonus also applies to Cold and Lightning; their own bonuses are half as effective.

nodes.name: Delayed Demolition
nodes.description: 40% of hit damage is delayed 2 seconds, then dealt with 50% more damage. If the target dies first, it is lost.

nodes.name: Profane Bloom
nodes.description: Enemies that die cursed by you explode for 15% of their Max HP as Chaos damage. The blast cannot chain.

nodes.name: Malediction
nodes.description: Enemies hold one of your curses, with 75% stronger numeric effects. A new curse replaces the old one.

nodes.name: Inevitable Judgement
nodes.description: Elemental damage from critical hits ignores resistance, but non-critical Elemental damage is 20% lower.

nodes.name: Aura Resonance
nodes.description: Each active aura lowers every aura reservation by 5% and raises its effect by 5%, to a 30% cap each.

nodes.name: Escape Artist
nodes.description: After 3 seconds without losing HP or ES, restore 50% of Max ES, repeating every 3 seconds. No natural ES regeneration.

nodes.name: Mind over Matter
nodes.description: 30% of damage that would hit HP is paid from unreserved Mana at 1:1.

nodes.name: Arcane Battery
nodes.description: Reserve 40% of Max Mana to gain twice that much Energy Shield. The reserved Mana cannot be spent.

nodes.name: Dark Siphon
nodes.description: Life Leech and Mana Regeneration restore Energy Shield instead of HP and Mana.

nodes.name: Elemental Aegis
nodes.description: Energy Shield takes 30% less Elemental damage, but Physical hits bypass it and strike HP directly.

nodes.name: Mana Debt
nodes.description: Mana costs may borrow down to 50% of usable Max Mana. While in debt, Mana Regeneration is doubled but positive-cost skills are refused.

nodes.name: Blood Covenant
nodes.description: Choose per aura whether it reserves HP or Mana. An HP reservation reduces usable HP, not Max HP.

nodes.name: Chaos Inoculation
nodes.description: Max HP becomes 1 and you are immune to Chaos damage. Other damage, including Poison and Bleed, hits ES first. You are never on Low Life.

nodes.name: Capacitive Casting
nodes.description: 20% of Mana actually paid for a skill restores ES, but natural ES regeneration is halved.

nodes.name: Berserk
nodes.description: While on Low Life: 40% more damage and 25% more attack speed. You always take 15% more damage.

nodes.name: Endless Hunger
nodes.description: Excess Life Leech is banked, up to 20% of the destination pool for 10 seconds, then refills you when you are missing pool. No HP regeneration.

nodes.name: Fortress Under Siege
nodes.description: Taking a hit grants Fortify, up to 5 stacks; each stack reduces later hits by 5%. Stacks fade after 4 seconds without taking damage.

nodes.name: Master Surgeon
nodes.description: HP potions heal over 4 seconds for 50% more total; a new HP potion is refused while one is still healing.

nodes.name: Radiant Faith
nodes.description: Reserve 25% of Max HP; each hit is reduced by a flat 10% of that reserve, up to 30% of the hit.

nodes.name: Time of Need
nodes.description: Every 5 seconds, clear Burn, Poison and Bleed and restore 15% of Max HP. No HP regeneration.

nodes.name: Blood Price
nodes.description: Skill Mana costs are paid as HP at 1:1. A cast is refused if it would leave you below 1 HP.

nodes.name: Borrowed Time
nodes.description: 40% of HP lost to enemy hits is recovered over 6 seconds. You cannot Life Leech.

nodes.name: Enduring Core
nodes.description: Damage that strikes HP below 30% of Max HP is halved. You have no Energy Shield.

nodes.name: Staggering Resolve
nodes.description: 40% of enemy hit damage that would strike HP is instead paid over 5 seconds. Cleansing does not remove it.

nodes.name: Parasitic Affliction
nodes.description: Gain 2% Life Leech, and all Life Leech works on your damage over time instead of hits.

nodes.name: Ambush
nodes.description: A hit that could crit always crits a full-HP target; afterwards crit chance against that target is halved.

nodes.name: Toxic Execution
nodes.description: Critical hits deal no extra damage themselves; the crit bonus becomes Poison over 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Turtle Doctrine
nodes.description: Block becomes a flat Physical damage reduction equal to its average chance. Block events no longer occur.
